descriptions.inProgress: I ran into #p2081004#, who's responsible for singing for the egg at #m240000000#. #p2081004# liked to sing, but was also interested in playing instruments, and wanted to make a big flute. In order to do so, she asked that I gather up #b50 #t4000231#s
